headline: If Traffic Challan Is Not Paid, Fine May Be Added to Electricity Bill; Supreme Court Suggests Remedy: ₹20,000 Crore Challans Outstanding
summary: The Supreme Court said issuing traffic challans is not enough and effective recovery of fines is needed. It raised adding pending challan amounts, reported at ₹20,000 crore, to electricity bills.
why: Unpaid government fines and their recovery mechanisms affect public finances and enforcement policy. Changes to how levies are collected can influence state revenue.
